lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad marahu phir jeevahu sad hee taa phir maran na hoee ||
lines.translation: Dying in the Word of the Shabad, you shall live forever, and you shall never die again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam sadaa man meethaa sabade paavai koee ||3||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam is ever-sweet to the mind; but how few are those who obtain the Shabad. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤੈ ਦਾਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਹਥਿ ਅਪਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: daatai daat rakhee hath apanai jis bhaavai tis deee ||
lines.translation: The Great Giver keeps His Gifts in His Hand; He gives them to those with whom He is pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਪਹਿ ਸੇਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate sukh paaiaa daragah jaapahi seee ||4||11||
lines.translation: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, they find peace, and in the Court of the Lord, they are exalted. ||4||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve taa sahaj dhun upajai gat mat tad hee paae ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, the divine melody wells up within, and one is blessed with wisdom and salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam sachaa man vasiaa naame naam samaae ||1||
lines.translation: The True Name of the Lord comes to abide in the mind, and through the Name, one merges in the Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur sabh jag bauraanaa ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, the whole world is insane.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਝੂਠੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa sabad na jaanai jhoothai bharam bhulaanaa || rahaau ||
lines.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not realize the Word of the Shabad; they are deluded by false doubts. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun maaiaa bharam bhulaaiaa haumai ba(n)dhan kamaae ||
lines.translation: The three-faced Maya had led them astray in doubt, and they are snared by the noose of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਊਭਉ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)man maran sir oopar oobhau garabh jon dukh paae ||2||
lines.translation: Birth and death hang over their heads, and being reborn from the womb, they suffer in pain. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun varatahi sagal sa(n)saaraa haumai vich pat khoee ||
lines.translation: The three qualities permeate the whole world; acting in ego, it loses its honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਚਉਥਾ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai chauthaa pad cheenai raam naam sukh hoee ||3||
lines.translation: But one who becomes Gurmukh comes to realize the fourth state of celestial bliss; he finds peace through the Name of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun sabh tere too aape karataa jo too karahi s hoee ||
lines.translation: The three qualities are all Yours, O Lord; You Yourself created them. Whatever You do, comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam nisataaraa sabade haumai khoee ||4||12||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, one is emancipated; through the Shabad, he is rid of egotism. ||4||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape aap varatadaa piaaraa aape aap apaahu ||
lines.translation: My Beloved Lord Himself pervades and permeates all; He Himself is, all by Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vanajaaraa jag aap hai piaaraa aape saachaa saahu ||
lines.translation: My Beloved Himself is the trader in this world; He Himself is the true banker.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape vanaj vaapaareeaa piaaraa aape sach vesaahu ||1||
lines.translation: My Beloved Himself is the trade and the trader; He Himself is the true credit. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap man har har naam salaah ||
lines.translation: O mind, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, and praise His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te paaeeai piaaraa a(n)mrit agam athaah || rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Beloved, Ambrosial, unapproachable and unfathomable Lord is obtained. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਭ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਹਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sun sabh vekhadaa piaaraa mukh bole aap muhaahu ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself sees and hears everything; He Himself speaks through the mouths of all beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape ujhaR paaidaa piaaraa aap vikhaale raahu ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself leads us into the wilderness, and He Himself shows us the Way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape hee sabh aap hai piaaraa aape veparavaahu ||2||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself is Himself all-in-all; He Himself is carefree. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਧੰਧੜੈ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape aap upaaidaa piaaraa sir aape dha(n)dhaRai laahu ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself, all by Himself, created everything; He Himself links all to their tasks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap karaae saakhatee piaaraa aap maare mar jaahu ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself creates the Creation, and He Himself destroys it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਤਣੁ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aape patan paatanee piaaraa aape paar la(n)ghaahu ||3||
lines.translation: He Himself is the wharf, and He Himself is the ferryman, who ferries us across. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape saagar bohithaa piaaraa gur khevat aap chalaahu ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself is the ocean, and the boat; He Himself is the Guru, the boatman who steers it

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape hee chaR la(n)ghadaa piaaraa kar choj vekhai paatisaahu ||
lines.translation: . The Beloved Himself sets sail and crosses over; He, the King, beholds His wondrous play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਹੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape aap daiaal hai piaaraa jan naanak bakhas milaahu ||4||1||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself is the Merciful Master; O servant Nanak, He forgives and blends with Himself. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 chauthaa ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਆਪੇ ਖੰਡ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape a(n)daj jeraj setaj utabhuj aape kha(n)d aape sabh loi ||
lines.translation: He Himself is born of the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; He Himself is the continents and all the worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੂਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਣੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਕਤੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape soot aape bahu maneeaa kar sakatee jagat paroi ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the thread, and He Himself is the many beads; through His Almighty Power, He has strung the worlds.
